authority.source_authority: This DAD worktree retains source authority; model observations and research findings remain dated candidate evidence.

non_overlap_statement: Only local-foreman-writer may edit the implementation; all delegated roles are read-only and the independent checker cannot modify writer outputs.

roles.why_needed: A single bounded writer must reconcile the skill, registries, schemas, graph surfaces, CLI, and tests.
roles.mission: Implement the model-independent ML agent family in this isolated DAD worktree.
inputs: existing governed registries and skill contracts
roles.authority: May write only the bounded ML family, navigation, registry, CLI, test, and evidence surfaces in this worktree.
acceptance_conditions: The family is provider- and model-independent at stable identity boundaries.
Schemas, registries, CLI, tests, and skill validation pass.
Research and global activation remain human-gated.
stop_conditions: A change would install global state, schedule automation, or cross repository authority boundaries.
A required learning-rule acknowledgement is missing.

readiness_conditions: Targeted tests and deterministic validators pass.

roles.why_needed: The repository requires reuse discovery before new reusable assets are created.
roles.mission: Identify reusable contracts and complete privacy-safe post-build learning, asset, prompt, and reuse discovery.
roles.authority: Read-only discovery; cannot edit or promote candidate assets.
acceptance_conditions: Reusable assets and material gaps are reported with paths.
stop_conditions: Discovery would require private payloads or external mutation.

readiness_conditions: Relevant registries and skill contracts have been inspected.

roles.why_needed: The cross-cutting authority, routing, lifecycle, and model-adapter design needs an independent architecture challenge.
roles.mission: Define and red-team the model-independent architecture and acceptance gates.
roles.authority: Read-only architecture advice; cannot edit or create a competing routing authority.
acceptance_conditions: Stable identities are separated from dated runtime adapter observations.
Existing mesh and peer-review skills remain sole routing authorities.
stop_conditions: The proposal creates a second canonical model alias or routing authority.

roles.why_needed: A validation attempt crossed the deterministic long-run review threshold and required measured attribution before any optimization proposal.
roles.mission: Profile validation and test latency, consider algorithm, library, runtime, and Rust boundaries, and reject unsupported rewrites.
roles.authority: Read-only optimization review; cannot edit, add dependencies, move governance semantics, or authorize a builder.
acceptance_conditions: Bottlenecks, parity requirements, and disposition are evidence-backed.
Rust is considered only behind a measured deterministic boundary.
stop_conditions: No reproducible hotspot earns a bounded experiment.
A candidate would weaken correctness or governance.

readiness_conditions: A normalized command crosses the long-run trigger.

roles.why_needed: A separate checker must verify the writer did not create false authority, unsafe activation, or regression risk.
roles.mission: Independently review the final diff, graph semantics, lifecycle gates, privacy boundaries, and test evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only verification; cannot mutate the writer scope or approve external activation.
acceptance_conditions: All material findings have evidence and a release disposition.
stop_conditions: The checker would need to edit the implementation or becomes the writer.

readiness_conditions: Final diff and validation evidence are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove stable family and role identities do not depend on a provider or current model name.
Prove global installation, recurring research, promotion, and external mutation are not silently activated.
Prove dependencies and governance relationships are typed, directional, candidate-labelled, and queryable upstream and downstream.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Installing the skill into the live global personal-skill surface remains a separate human-approved action after review or merge.
Activating the P14D research scheduler remains unscheduled until a human selects sources, runtime, budget, and publication boundary.

reconciliations.reason: The same read-only scout completed the required post-build learning and asset-discovery lanes without expanding authority.
Measured validation and test durations crossed the long-run review trigger after the execution manifest was created.
The declared checker found and independently replayed midflight, graph coverage, and canonical-ID fixes before issuing a pass gate.
